name: Squats
description: A squat is lowering the body by bending the knees and hips. Lower until the thighs are below parallel, then stand back up.

items.content: Feet about shoulder width apart, toes slightly out

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Deepest squat, thighs below parallel, knees over the toes, chest up, arms forward.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Standing tall, hips and knees locked, arms forward.
